summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author-controlled webhook
details: Xerohub_Voice.js defines a hardcoded Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/...) as the fallback destination for DEVELOPER_BACKEND_WEBHOOK. The exported startVoiceJoiner() flow builds a message that embeds the caller-supplied Discord user token verbatim (`Token: ${details.token}`) along with username, serverId, and channelId, and POSTs that payload via axios.post to the hardcoded webhook on every invocation. The package's advertised purpose (joining a Discord voice channel) requires the token to reach Discord's gateway, not an author-owned webhook; the additional relay is an undisclosed credential exfiltration path. A Discord user token grants full account takeover of the caller's Discord account.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
